item.title: Group reports by account and currency
item.brief: Update reports.py per the shared contract: read new CSV with currency and legacy CSV without currency (default USD); validate present currency as exactly three uppercase ASCII letters; malformed currency prints an error to stderr and exits 2. Sum by account and currency and emit header account,currency,total_cents with rows sorted by account then currency. Update README, run python3 -m unittest, and commit changes. Preserve existing behavior otherwise.

pr.body: Updated reports.py to accept current currency CSV and legacy CSV, validate currency as three uppercase ASCII letters, report malformed currency to stderr with exit 2, and sort output by account then currency. README documents both input formats and output. Added tests for legacy USD defaults, grouping/sorting, and malformed currency. Checks passed: python3 -m unittest (3 tests), git diff --check. Assumption: a present but empty currency value is malformed.

item.title: Add transaction currency to ledger TSV and CSV
item.brief: Update the Rust ledger CLI per the shared contract: accept optional fourth TSV currency field defaulting to USD; emit currency column in CSV header and all rows; validate exactly three uppercase ASCII letters. Invalid currency must report the input line number on stderr and exit 2, while other input errors remain exit 1. Update README, run cargo test, and commit changes. Preserve existing behavior otherwise.
